ideas.pitch: A rapid automated feature engineering and drift detection pipeline built for the 48-hour Kaggle qualifier that automatically alerts when challenge distribution shifts occur.
ideas.title: Kaggle Auto-Feature & Dynamic Drift Adaptor

ideas.pitch: A solo-friendly platform that ingests tabular datasets and trained model predictions to detect, explain, and automatically mitigate demographic and feature-based biases.
